name: Gorbold Steelhand
summary: In Auberdine, Gorbold Steelhand keeps trade moving along Darkshore’s coast. The dwarven merchant brings goods across the Great Sea for travelers, crafters, and night elves.

sections.title: A Dwarven Trader in Kalimdor
sections.body: Gorbold Steelhand carries Ironforge trade to Auberdine. Night elves live across much of northern Kalimdor, and Alliance outposts rely on merchants who cross the Great Sea. Gorbold works alongside the kaldorei, selling trade goods, reagents, crafting supplies, and tools. Travelers visit him before exploring Darkshore’s dangerous shores and forests.

sections.title: Maritime Ventures
sections.body: Gorbold Steelhand keeps watch on the perilous waters off Auberdine as well as his stock. Reefs along Darkshore have swallowed Alliance vessels, and their lost cargo interests the merchant. Travelers who dive into the deep ocean may find him eager to hear of salvage and lost logs from sunken wrecks.

faq.answer: Gorbold Steelhand is a dwarven merchant in Auberdine, Darkshore’s coastal port.
Gorbold Steelhand sells trade supplies, crafting ingredients, gathering tools, and reagents such as vials and thread to tradesfolk passing through Auberdine.

faq.q: Why is an Ironforge dwarf living in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Auberdine links Kalimdor to the Eastern Kingdoms as an Alliance transit hub. Dwarves travel there for commerce, exploration, and to support allied night elf operations.

aliases: deep ocean vast sea quest giver
faq.answer: Yes. Gorbold Steelhand sends adventurers to recover lost ship cargo from wreckage off Darkshore in 'Deep Ocean, Vast Sea'.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Gorbold Steelhand in Darkshore’s misty, nocturnal surroundings may remind you of home in Ironforge.
As an Alliance member, you can see Gorbold Steelhand helping eastern Alliance races and night elves keep trade flowing across the Great Sea.
